a: OpenAPI 3 is a widely used specification for HTTP APIs.
Swagger UI renders interactive docs from OpenAPI specs.
ReDoc is another popular OpenAPI documentation renderer.
Mock servers let clients integrate before backends are ready.
Contract-first design writes the API spec before implementation.
Code-first generates specs from implementation annotations.
Use consistent error codes and human-readable messages.
Give clients time to migrate before removing endpoints.
Partner portals host keys, docs, and usage dashboards.
